summary:
The group spec is written, measured at c6fb6533: 120,152 bytes, pure ASCII, LF, written by the shell with cat. The worktree stays clean (`git status --short` is empty; `.qa-s80/` is gitignored).

Design: every G2 file goes under `scripts/` and no `app/` file is edited, so the flag-OFF state is byte-identical by construction. This is forced by measured guards: u3c_02 forbids any Anthropic Batches call under `app/`; T7b would need `processors.json` rows (legal text) for a new URL in `app/services`; S81-15 p5 and r43 forbid `app/` naming `robots_registry` or the scripts; the claude- literal pin covers `app/services`; the D9 `/bot` pin forbids the words QarenBot and NAMED_AGENT in any new `.py` text.

Shared module `scripts/kb_seed_common.py` holds:
- the mode reader, the same for the three units: unset/false means OFF; true/1/yes/on means DRY RUN; `apply` means write;
- the paged `kb_merchants` read;
- the fail-closed URL gate: `jsonld_widen.rating_host_allowed` plus a check that the record's origin is the URL's own origin, plus an optional ToS check;
- the polite named-UA fetch: `robots_registry` Politeness, `_fetch_following`, `default_fetch` and `default_validate`;
- the KbWriter: rows only from the S81-14 builders; insert-ignore; offers follow the R-S14-1 observation contract with one shared timestamp.

Per unit:
- **S81-16:** ONE Haiku 5.5 Message Batch per run over held corpus pages that pass the robots gate (`thinking` disabled, `output_config` JSON schema, `max_tokens` 2048, usage logged for the first 20 rows, the batch deleted after the writes). Writes kb_products, kb_variants and cited kb_specs; the provenance of each field is its `source_url`. No offers (the corpus has no capture time) and no images. Spend runs through the S81-04 offclock reserve/settle, the 050 ledger row and an in-script bound `KB_SEED_MAX_USD` <= 10; the S81-06 router is not used. The Wikidata brand import writes kb_merchants CANDIDATE rows only.
- **D09:** Shopify and Woo Store API readers cover 19 of the 24 feed hosts; 5 are `no_reader`. A host needs `tos.verdict` allowed and a known registry currency. Shopify offers carry the registry currency with rung `expected_missing`, and a per-handle `price_currency` probe guards each host.
- **D11:** reads the robots-declared sitemaps of the 71 JSON-LD hosts through the existing `_collect_slugs_for_index` (no Redis write). The Common Crawl CDX leg is inert without `ENABLE_CC_CDX` and `KB_CC_INDEX`. Only URLs that match a ranked juice become `queued` kb_gaps rows.

Findings:
- The DEFECT_LEDGER has no S81-16, D09 or D11 rows.
- Of the held corpora, only 47 Gulf and 3 global juices have a registry row with a robots record on their own origin, so the 500 / 2,000 targets must come from D09 and D11.
- 045 has no column for brand labels.
- No SDK pin change is needed: anthropic 1.12.1 is in the locks and installed.

Totals: 63 RED rows, 14 PIN rows, 45 mutants. The comm set is 68 files at base and 71 at head.

stated_limits: S16-L1 the held corpora seed at most 47 Gulf + 3 global juices under the registry rule; the 500 / 2,000 targets rest on D09 / D11 / S81-19
S16-L2 captured_at / updated_at of seeded rows = the run time (the manifests carry no capture time)
S16-L3 no offers and no images from the corpus
S16-L4 concentration from the title only; the model never sets identity
S16-L5 a resumed batch leaves its original reserve charged for its Riyadh day
S16-L6 the upper bound uses sync rates (2x the batch price)
S16-L7 the Wikidata ids (P1056 / Q131746 / P856) are unverified offline; brand labels are not stored
S16-L8 brand candidates join the robots cron set; above ROBOTS_CRON_MAX_HOSTS (500) some hosts are read every other day
S16-L9 the page-wide deny-link rule also skips pages whose deny link is unrelated
S16-L10 Arabic lang by script detection
D09-L1 5 of 24 hosts no_reader (Magento GraphQL x2, Salla x2, Algolia x1) -> D09b
D09-L2 Woo products without a brands field are skipped
D09-L3 Shopify bulk offers rest on the registry currency (rung expected_missing); at most 3 per-handle probes per host
D09-L4 challenged hosts are not parked by D09 (the robots cron owns challenge)
D09-L5 one UPDATE per re-observed offer
D09-L6 no images from feeds (no kb_images.source value)
D09-L7 FEED_WALKER_MAX_PAGES bounds a host per run
D11-L1 discovery hints only; PDP fetching is S81-19
D11-L2 .xml.gz sitemaps and children over 3,000,000 bytes are not parsed
D11-L3 slug-keyed collection keeps the last URL per slug; the shipped matcher
D11-L4 the robots.txt of index.commoncrawl.org is not read (Terms sign-off is the gate)
D11-L5 an empty KB matches nothing (APPLY after D09 APPLY)
D11-L6 ranking by offers only until S81-17 demand rows exist
D11-L7 the CDX request shape is untested against the network
focus_surfaces_found: S81-16 secrets or key handling (borderline, consumption only): the seeder reads the EXISTING ANTHROPIC_API_KEY once at import (the seed_spec_spine :69 snapshot pattern) and passes it to anthropic.Anthropic; never logged or stored; no new credential name. Proposed SAFE; ruling asked as Q-S16-4

S81-16 Redis / Lua (consumption only, no code touched): calls the existing llm_spend_breaker.reserve / settle / record (S81-04 Upstash Lua EVALs) on the offclock lane only when ENABLE_LLM_SPEND_BREAKER is ON on the kbseed service. Proposed SAFE

D09 and D11: no FOCUS surface touched (no auth, quota, legal / privacy text, consent, security middleware, migration, Redis, App-Review client surface or key); the SSRF validator and robots machinery are consumed unchanged
open_questions: Q-S16-1 / Q-G2-1 the shared mode idiom: env value true = DRY RUN, apply = write (recommended) vs a CLI --apply
Q-S16-2 the seeder writes no offers and no images from the held corpora although the brief lists build_offer_row / build_image_row (recommended: yes, no capture time; image recheck belongs to S81-19)

Q-S16-3 Wikidata target: kb_merchants CANDIDATE rows for official brand hosts (045 has no brand-label column) vs DRY RUN only until a brands table exists (a migration = FOCUS); recommended candidate rows, cap 300
Q-S16-4 is reading the existing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in a script the FOCUS surface 'secrets or key handling'? recommended: no
Q-S16-5 page-wide deny-link skip vs a proximity rule (recommended page-wide)
Q-D09-1 accept 19 of 24 feed hosts now and open D09b for Magento GraphQL / Salla / Algolia (recommended yes)
Q-D09-2 keep the per-handle Shopify currency probe as a host-level guard beyond the brief (recommended keep)
Q-D09-3 Woo products without a brands field: skip (recommended) vs title-prefix matching
Q-D11-1 discovery sink = kb_gaps keyed (kb_product_id, pdp_<sha256(host)[:16]>), state queued, source_hint the canonical URL (recommended)
Q-D11-2 D11 requires robots only, no ToS verdict (recommended yes); D09 requires both
Q-D11-3 PDP URL shapes follow ENABLE_SITEMAP_PDP_MARKERS_V2 (one recogniser; the owner sets it on the D11 service if the dry run shows the gain)
Q-G2-2 the /bot landing page names the agent as the site-discovery crawler; no legal-text change in G2 (recommended), the owner may ask later
Q-G2-3 three Railway services (one per job, recommended) vs one
